title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch with Integrated Towel Bar, Wall Mount Solid Brass | Waverly Place Allied Brass
description:
Add storage and hanging space with a 16-Inch glass shelf that includes an integrated towel bar—ideal as a bathroom vanity shelf for daily essentials. Crafted with 3/8-Inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass and solid brass hardware, this wall mount shelf helps keep counters organized while saving floor space. Designed for the Waverly Place Collection, it coordinates with matching Waverly Place pieces for a pulled-together look in transitional bath accessories or transitional bathroom hardware settings.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted glass shelf for bathroom or vanity use
- Integrated towel bar for hand towels
- 16 x 5-Inch shelf size; 5-Inch projection
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass; beveled edge
- Solid brass hardware with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Category: Glass Shelves
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Style: Traditional; pairs well with versatile bath accessories
